result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders item in the bottom navigation is missing its icon while the other tabs render normally.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab has a label but no icon above it, while Home, Search, and Profile each show an icon. The empty icon slot makes the tab look broken and inconsistent with the rest of the bar.
issues.suggestion: Render an Orders icon (such as a receipt or bag glyph) in the same size, weight, and gray color as the other inactive tab icons so all four tabs are visually consistent.
